# Oxford Power Contracting LLC (Oxford Building Contracting)

Oxford Power Contracting LLC (operating as Oxford Building Contracting) is a premier general contracting company based in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates (UAE). Serving developers and private clients globally across high-spec commercial, residential, healthcare, and industrial sectors.

## Core Coordinates & Identity
- **Legal Name:** Oxford Power Contracting LLC
- **Trade Name:** Oxford Building Contracting
- **Tagline:** Shaping Skylines, Building Landmarks
- **Address:** Faisal 2 Building, Office 405, King Faisal St, Al Nad - Hay Al Qasimiah, Sharjah, UAE
- **Telephone / WhatsApp:** +971 50 418 1220 (WhatsApp Support Enabled)
- **Primary Email:** INFO@OXFORDPWC.COM
- **Official Website:** https://oxford-power-contracting-llc.vercel.app/
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/eypWWP197uUBnsrm7
- **Established Year:** 2006 (20+ Years of UAE Heritage)
- **Status:** DEWA Registered (No: DEWA-CONTR-2008-8429), Sharjah Municipal Approved

## Key Service Verticals
- **Construction Project Management:** End-to-end turnkey FIDIC-compliant execution, municipal & Civil Defence approvals, cost control, site QA/QC.
- **Civil Engineering:** Reinforced Concrete (RCC) structures, piling, foundation shoring, structural steel erection.
- **MEP and Civil Integrated Solutions:** Clutter-free coordination of structural, mechanical, plumbing, and electrical works to prevent clash detection.
- **DEWA-Certified Electrical Installations:** Low & Medium Voltage cabling, substations (11kV), transformer room civil/electrical works.
- **HVAC & Chilled Water Systems:** Chilled water networks, VRF, duct fabrication, municipal air balancing compliance.
- **Fire Alarm & Fire Fighting:** Addressable system installations, emergency lighting, central battery cabinets, direct Hassantuk interface.
- **Telecommunication (Du/Etisalat):** Structured fiber networks, structured cabling, statutory NOC procurement.
- **Architectural Fit-Out & Finishes:** High-end marble bookmatching, acoustic ceilings, porcelain cladding, luxury building envelopes.

## Landmark Projects
- **Majestic Commercial Tower (Dubai):** G+22 office tower featuring comprehensive MEP energization and complete civil structural design.
- **Sheikh Zayed Road Residential Complex (Dubai):** Twin-tower luxury development featuring complex HVAC systems and custom substations.
- **Sharjah Industrial Warehouse Hub:** Ultra-span steel structural design with integrated logistics layout and fire defense networks.
- **Al Zahia Luxury Villa Enclave (Sharjah):** Premium private residence featuring bespoke marble fit-out, MEP, smart automation, and private pool.

## Operational Standards & QA
- **Zero-Incident Safety Culture:** 1.2 Million+ safe man-hours without Lost Time Injury (LTI).
- **ISO Quality Compliance:** ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment), ISO 45001 (Health & Safety) standards.
